name: Exp_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_Digit_NN3_MMRec
summary: This EA uses an Absolutely No Lag LWMA (Linear Weighted Moving Average) Digit indicator combined with a 3-layer Neural Network (NN3) for signal generation, enhanced with Money Management Recommendation (MMRec) for position sizing. It identifies trend direction through the no-lag LWMA and feeds digit patterns into a neural network to classify trade signals, then applies money management rules to calculate optimal lot sizes.
summary_zh: 该EA使用绝对无滞后LWMA数字指标结合三层神经网络(NN3)生成交易信号，并通过资金管理推荐(MMRec)进行仓位管理。它通过无滞后LWMA识别趋势方向，将数字模式输入神经网络分类交易信号，然后应用资金管理规则计算最优手数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于绝对无滞后线性加权移动平均线(LWMA)消除传统移动平均线的滞后性，将其数值转化为数字模式后输入三层前馈神经网络进行信号分类。入场条件：神经网络输出买入信号时做多，输出卖出信号时做空，LWMA方向作为趋势过滤确认。出场条件：反向神经网络信号触发平仓，或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理通过MMRec模块根据账户余额、风险比例和止损距离动态计算交易手数。资金管理采用固定风险百分比模式，每笔交易风险控制在账户余额的预设比例内，同时考虑止损距离来确定仓位大小。该策略结合了趋势跟踪与模式识别的优势，神经网络通过历史数据训练学习最优的数字模式到交易信号的映射关系。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Absolutely No Lag LWMA which eliminates the lag inherent in traditional moving averages, converting its values into digit patterns that are fed into a 3-layer feedforward neural network for signal classification. Entry conditions: long positions when the neural network outputs a buy signal, short positions on sell signals, with the LWMA direction serving as a trend filter confirmation. Exit conditions: positions are closed on reverse neural network signals or when stop loss/take profit targets are reached. Position sizing is dynamically calculated through the MMRec module based on account balance, risk percentage, and stop loss distance. Money management employs a fixed fractional model where each trade risks a pre-set percentage of account equity, with position size determined by the ratio of dollar risk to stop loss distance in points. The strategy combines trend-following with pattern recognition advantages, where the neural network learns the optimal mapping from digit patterns to trading signals through historical data training.

pros: 结合无滞后LWMA与神经网络，信号生成具有较强的自适应性和模式识别能力
资金管理模块根据风险比例动态计算手数，有效控制单笔交易风险
使用无滞后移动平均线减少了传统MA指标的滞后缺陷，信号更及时
止损止盈设置完整，风险边界明确
点差过滤机制避免在高点差环境下入场
pros_en: Combines no-lag LWMA with neural network for adaptive signal generation with strong pattern recognition capability
Money management module dynamically calculates lot size based on risk percentage, effectively controlling per-trade risk
No-lag moving average reduces the lag defect of traditional MA indicators, providing more timely signals
Complete stop loss and take profit settings with clear risk boundaries
Spread filter mechanism avoids entering trades in high-spread environments
cons: 神经网络权重需要预训练，如果市场状态变化与训练数据分布不同，模型表现可能严重退化
无滞后LWMA虽然减少滞后，但在震荡市中仍可能产生频繁的虚假信号
缺乏对市场波动率(如ATR)的自适应调整机制，止损止盈为固定点数
三层神经网络结构相对简单，可能无法捕捉复杂的市场非线性关系
未明确提及新K线检查机制，可能存在同根K线重复开仓风险
cons_en: Neural network weights require pre-training; performance may severely degrade when market regime differs from training data distribution
No-lag LWMA, while reducing lag, can still generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
Lacks adaptive adjustment mechanism for market volatility (e.g., ATR), using fixed-point stop loss and take profit
Three-layer neural network structure is relatively simple and may not capture complex non-linear market relationships
No explicit new bar check mechanism mentioned, posing risk of duplicate entries on the same bar
improvements: 引入ATR自适应止损止盈，替代固定点数设置，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
增加新K线检查机制防止同根重复开仓，并加入震荡市过滤器(如ADX)减少虚假信号
增加神经网络在线学习或定期重训练机制，使模型适应市场状态变化
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based adaptive stop loss/take profit to replace fixed-point settings, making risk management responsive to market volatility changes
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar, and include a ranging market filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals
Add online learning or periodic retraining mechanism for the neural network to adapt to changing market regimes

risk_points: 固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能止损过近导致频繁止损
神经网络在市场状态切换时可能持续发出错误信号，缺乏状态检测和熔断机制
缺乏明确的新K线检查，存在同根K线重复开仓的潜在风险
risk_points_en: Fixed-point stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility changes; stop loss may be too close during high volatility causing frequent stops
Neural network may continuously generate wrong signals during market regime shifts, lacking regime detection and circuit breaker mechanisms
Lack of explicit new bar check poses potential risk of duplicate entries on the same candle
